---
name: ✨ Improvement
about: Propose a starter improvement (pattern, helper, tooling)
title: "[improvement] "

---

## What

Describe the improvement in 1–2 sentences.

## Why

What problem does it solve? Recurring pain? Pattern duplicated across apps?

## Who benefits

List apps that use or would use this improvement (≥ 2 to justify).

## Alternative considered

Why not an external lib / why not just in your own app fork?

## Impact

- [ ] Breaking change (requires migration of derived apps)
- [ ] Adds a dependency
- [ ] Changes public API of the starter
- [ ] Changes DB schema / requires migration
